questions.question: How is alcohol removed from your system?
questions.explanation: Your liver removes alcohol at a fixed rate. Only time allows your body to remove alcohol naturally.

questions.question: Operating combination vehicles requires ____ skill than operating single vehicles.
questions.explanation: Combination vehicles are heavier and longer than single vehicles. They require more driving skill to operate safely.

questions.question: When backing up, backing toward the driver's side:

options.text: Is only recommended if it is raining.

questions.explanation: Back toward the driver's side whenever possible. This gives you the best view of your path.

questions.question: When traveling down a steep hill, shift to a lower gear:

options.text: After you have started the hill.
As far down the hill as possible.

questions.explanation: Shift to a lower gear before going downhill. This prepares your vehicle for gravity pulling you faster downhill.

questions.question: When backing with a trailer, turning toward the driver's side is encouraged because:

options.text: The driver will have the best possible view.
Power lines should be on the passenger's side.
Other drivers can offer assistance on the passenger's side.

questions.correctAnswerText: The driver will have the best possible view.
questions.explanation: Backing toward the left side gives you the best view of the rear of your vehicle.

questions.question: If you see a distracted driver ahead, you should:
questions.explanation: Give distracted drivers plenty of space. Maintain a safe following distance.

questions.question: Dual tires should:
questions.explanation: Dual tires must not touch each other or any other part of the vehicle.

questions.question: To check if a tractor protection valve works properly, you should:

options.text: Open all of the vehicle's shut-off valves.
Press the brake pedal to release air and watch for the emergency signal to activate.

questions.correctAnswerText: Press the brake pedal to release air and watch for the emergency signal to activate.
questions.explanation: Let the air supply charge fully. Turn off the engine. Press the brake pedal several times to release air. The tractor protection valve should move to emergency position when air pressure drops to an unsafe level.

questions.question: Truck tractors with air brakes built after March 1, 1997 must have:
questions.explanation: Truck tractors with air brakes built after March 1, 1997 must have anti-lock brakes installed.

questions.question: You should check and adjust your mirrors:
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors before you start driving. Your position changes day to day, so mirrors may need adjustment.

questions.question: To stay alert while driving, you should:

options.text: Eat a heavy meal before you start driving.
Drive with a second person who can take turns driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive with a second person who can take turns driving.
questions.explanation: Taking turns with another driver reduces the risk that either of you will drive while tired. You can also reduce tiredness by avoiding heavy foods and keeping the cab cool.

questions.question: To prevent your vehicle from rolling backward when you start moving, you can:

options.text: Partly engage the clutch before releasing the brake pedal.
Put the vehicle in second gear.
Use the parking brake when you stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Partly engage the clutch before releasing the brake pedal.
questions.explanation: To prevent your vehicle from rolling backward when you start moving after a stop, partly engage the clutch before you release the brake pedal.

questions.question: If the low air pressure warning light comes on, you should:

options.text: Keep driving, but have the brakes fixed within a week.
Pull over and check the brakes.
Call a mechanic while you are driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull over and check the brakes.
questions.explanation: If the low air pressure warning light comes on while driving a vehicle with air brakes, stop the vehicle immediately while you still have brake control. Check and repair the brakes right away.

questions.question: When making a left turn, you should start the turn:

options.text: Before you reach the center of the intersection.
At or after you reach the center of the intersection.
After your rear wheels pass the center of the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: At or after you reach the center of the intersection.
questions.explanation: Wait until you reach the center of the intersection before you start turning left. If you turn too early, the left side of your vehicle could hit another vehicle because of off-tracking.

questions.question: The "crack-the-whip" effect for doubles and triples is:

options.text: Only a problem when it is raining.

questions.explanation: Double and triple trailers are more likely to roll over because of the "crack-the-whip" effect. Drivers must steer gently when pulling trailers.

questions.question: A distracted driver:

options.text: Is a good driver to follow.

questions.explanation: Distracted drivers see road hazards more slowly than focused drivers. They may not see hazards at all.

questions.question: When braking with ABS, you should:
questions.explanation: When braking a vehicle with an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS), brake the same way you would with any other braking system.

questions.question: A thin layer of ice on the road surface is called:
questions.explanation: Black ice is a thin, clear layer of ice on the road. You can see the road surface through it. A road with black ice looks wet. Be very careful when temperatures are below freezing and the road looks wet.

questions.question: A cargo van is:

options.text: Usually the same height whether it is loaded or empty.
Usually taller when it has a heavy load than when it has a light load.
Usually shorter when it has a heavy load than when it has a light load.

questions.correctAnswerText: Usually shorter when it has a heavy load than when it has a light load.
questions.explanation: A heavy load makes a vehicle sit lower. A vehicle is usually taller with a light load than with a heavy load. If your vehicle fits under an overpass when fully loaded, it may not fit when the vehicle is empty.

questions.question: Radial and bias-ply tires:

options.text: Can be used together on the front of a vehicle.

questions.explanation: Do not use radial and bias-ply tires together. All tires on a vehicle should be the same type and size.
